title: Mixing: So Glad To See You Here, Winter Rose by Wings | 1978
content:
Replica Studio, London
Producers: Paul McCartney, Chris Thomas

Wings’ final studio session of 1978 took place on 18 December 1978.

This was primarily a mixing session for ‘So Glad To See You Here’, which the band had finished recording the previous day for the Back To The Egg album.

Also mixed in stereo on this day was ‘Winter Rose’, following the addition of a Mellotron overdub during an undocumented session earlier in the week.
